mapper.select: SELECT f.ID AS fileId, fs.FILENAME AS filename, f.ORIGINAL_FILENAME AS originalFilename, fs.FILE_ABSOLUTE_PATH AS fileAbsolutePath, fs.FILE_RELATIVE_PATH AS fileRelativePath, fs.FILE_ACCESS_URL AS fileAccessUrl FROM file_storage fs INNER JOIN file f ON f.STORAGE_ID = fs.ID INNER JOIN file_relation fr ON fr.FILE_ID = f.ID WHERE fr.BUSINESS_ID = #{businessId} AND fr.BUSINESS_TYPE = #{businessType}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM file_relation WHERE BUSINESS_ID = #{businessId} AND BUSINESS_TYPE = #{businessType}
